compute.hardware: Apple local CPU; no GPU. Dry run plus final fixed-seed analysis used 4.25 user seconds total; final-run peak memory was 1.00 GB.

observations: Contributor counts matched the task: lung fibroblast 2 young/5 old (n_common=36; 21 labels; minimum attainable p=1/21), lung NK 4/5 (35; 126; 1/126), and marrow granulocyte 2/10 (70; 66; 1/66), identically across shared seeds 0–2.

No type met the fixed reading rule: lung fibroblast failed in seed 0 (p=0.1838161838161838) despite seed 1/2 p=0.04595404595404595; lung NK passed only in seed 0 (p=0.012987012987012988); marrow granulocyte failed in all seeds (p=0.13786213786213786, 0.32167832167832167, 0.4775224775224775).
All three single-axis injection grids first passed at F=1.25 (the stated MDE).

The uniform ×2 control was false for lung fibroblast and marrow granulocyte but true for lung NK. Its slope and p exactly equal the lung-NK seed-0 real-data result (-0.0017878945499050205; p=0.012987012987012988), confirming scale invariance of the injection and identifying an inherited, unreplicated seed-0 baseline pass rather than a uniform-scaling effect.
suggestions: If an additional exploratory task is approved, enumerate the finite two-group label sets for the three basin types to characterize Monte Carlo threshold sensitivity at the low-label lung-fibroblast setting (21 distinct labels), without changing the frozen X06 result.
